cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The escape-room attendant found our shortcut. Phase one is working.

beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: Granted. Take five.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Don't open the delivery email. Let me deduce where our office biscuits went.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception signed for them. I'll tell everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Wait. That's a clue, not a conclusion. I should announce the solution.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too late. They're downstairs opening the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them nobody eats until I identify the contents. Finding a box doesn't mean they've solved the biscuits.

beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A

cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.
